ICS 87.080CHD 14Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the requirements for various types of pencils such as drawing pencils, carpenter’s pencils, stenographer’s and reporter’s pencils, and pencils for general writing.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:3084 : 1989 Pencil slats — Specification (second revision)1070 : 1992 Reagent grade water (third revision)
